mintAuthority.summary: Macropod centrally mints AUDM for approved clients: Ethereum, Base, and Redbelly share the same UUPS implementation and code-empty DEFAULT_ADMIN and MINTER_ROLE EOAs, while the Solana Token-2022 mint has a distinct System Program-owned wallet as mint authority.

controls.label: Macropod issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Macropod mints AUDM against AUD deposited into the AUDM Trust reserve by KYC/AML-approved clients and redeems 1:1; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: AUDM DEFAULT_ADMIN (Ethereum + Base + Redbelly)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531408, Base block 48624542, and Redbelly block 3061849, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x999071576cc6d7feadb908bede992ab9e19212cf) returned true on each AUDM UUPS proxy. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode for this address on all three chains, confirming one shared EOA control identity. On Redbelly, getRoleAdmin(UPGRADER_ROLE) and getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE) both returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The verified implementation gates UUPS upgrades with UPGRADER_ROLE, so this DEFAULT_ADMIN holder can grant the upgrade role and change mint logic.

controls.label: AUDM MINTER_ROLE holder (Ethereum + Base + Redbelly)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531408, Base block 48624542, and Redbelly block 3061849, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6, 0x3529a9f8193cce36df81123b59cdb4250219db39) returned true on each AUDM proxy. Exact-block eth_getCode returned no bytecode for this holder on all three chains, confirming the same EOA directly controls minting across the three EVM deployments. On Redbelly, getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE) returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: AUDM Solana mint authority (EOA wallet)
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432868722, getAccountInfo (jsonParsed) for Token-2022 mint CiYXBwHPrdNkMtxR8YEWKv78K6bQjFoEWhPQrZqEmubi returned mintAuthority = BS6KEeboF6Z2yDbxa8FD6UmPvorWwpm4QviYdpNpdAEQ. The authority account remained owned by the System Program (11111111111111111111111111111111), non-executable, and zero-data, confirming a distinct wallet authority.

review.evidence: Macropod documentation describes centralized, compliance-gated issuance against custodied AUD reserves. Exact-block reads confirmed the full EVM control graph at Ethereum block 25531408, Base block 48624542, and Redbelly block 3061849: Ethereum and Redbelly proxy 0x081599e4936d12c46bd48913b2329115cd26cbdd and Base proxy 0xeded6ae915b129b67a4ad49901518f2736427063 resolved to implementation 0xebadaf3d0ee4bbaa94717bd9029244b1df2f47aa; DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA 0x999071576cc6d7feadb908bede992ab9e19212cf and MINTER_ROLE EOA 0x3529a9f8193cce36df81123b59cdb4250219db39 retained their respective roles on all three chains. On Redbelly, the proxy had 170-byte UUPS runtime and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot; the implementation's proxiableUUID returned the canonical implementation slot, getRoleAdmin for UPGRADER_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE returned DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and verified source gates upgrades with UPGRADER_ROLE, allowing the default admin to grant it. At finalized Solana slot 432868722, Token-2022 mint CiYXBwHPrdNkMtxR8YEWKv78K6bQjFoEWhPQrZqEmubi retained mintAuthority BS6KEeboF6Z2yDbxa8FD6UmPvorWwpm4QviYdpNpdAEQ; that account was System Program-owned, non-executable, and zero-data. Hall Chadwick's 13 May 2026 independent agreed-upon-procedures report reconciled AUDM supply across Ethereum, Redbelly, and Solana to reserve bank accounts at 31 March 2026; Macropod publishes this as a quarterly series. No registry evidence established prudential supervision over AUDM reserve issuance.
